description: LEI lookup (GLEIF): find a company's Legal Entity Identifier by legal name, or get the full record by LEI: legal name, jurisdiction, entity and registration status, registered and headquarters address, and direct and ultimate parent companies. Use for KYB, company identity verification, counterparty identification and corporate ownership checks. Global coverage, CC0 data. Signed receipt. Price: $0.002 per call via x402 (USDC on Base or XRP on XRPL). The response includes a `provenance` block (sg-provenance/1): each fact carries its source, source URL, retrieval time and limits; evidence only, no score, rating or verdict. Example arguments: {"lei":"HWUPKR0MPOU8FGXBT394"}.
name: lei_lookup

outputSchema.description: Paid result: { data, receipt }. Unpaid calls return an x402 PaymentRequired object instead (isError: true).

data.description: GLEIF LEI record(s): legal name, jurisdiction, status, addresses, direct and ultimate parents

provenance.description: The response includes a `provenance` block (sg-provenance/1): each fact carries its source, source URL, retrieval time and limits; evidence only, no score, rating or verdict.

receipt.description: Ed25519-signed, hash-chained receipt; verify free with the verify_receipt tool or POST /v1/verify-receipt. New receipts carry a signed `evidence` object: service_version, data_timestamp, validation, terms_version, terms_hash, provenance_hash.

title: LEI Lookup (GLEIF)
